title: Caravan Towing Weight Ratio Calculator & Safety Guide
prompt: Create an interactive Caravan Towing Weight Ratio Calculator. Include HTML form inputs for Vehicle Kerbweight (kg) and Caravan MTPLM (kg), calculating the ratio percentage with safety warning levels (under 85% safe, 85-100% experienced only, over 100% dangerous). Add vanilla JS and complete practical towing advice.

title: Complete Off-Grid Caravan Solar Power Setup Guide
prompt: Write a comprehensive beginner-friendly guide on sizing off-grid caravan solar setups, covering panels, MPPT controllers, lithium batteries, and inverter choices with practical examples.

title: Daily Caravan Off-Grid Power Consumption Calculator
prompt: Build an interactive Off-Grid Power Consumption Calculator for caravans. Allow users to calculate daily amp-hour (Ah) consumption based on appliances (fridge, lights, water pump, devices) with pure HTML and vanilla JS embedded.
